capital.evidence_quote: Victoria is the capital and primate town of the Republic of Seychelles on Mahé island

currency.evidence_quote: The Seychelles Rupee (SCR) is the official currency; Euros and USD are accepted in resorts

timezone.evidence_quote: Seychelles operates year-round on Seychelles Time UTC+4 without daylight saving

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard single-phase low-voltage supply across Seychelles is 240V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Alternating grid frequency throughout the inner islands is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Wall sockets in Seychelles strictly adhere to the British three-rectangular-pin Type G design

police.evidence_quote: Dial 999 or 112 for emergency police services across the Seychelles

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 151 for emergency medical services and hospital ambulance dispatch

sources.title: Seychelles Fire and Rescue Services Agency (SFRSA)

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 999 for fire and rescue emergency operations

general.evidence_quote: 112 serves as the international unified mobile emergency number

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Seyşeller dünyanın en huzurlu ve güvenli ada destinasyonlarındandır; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Seychelles is extremely peaceful and secure; exercise normal travel precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Die Seychellen sind ein sehr friedliches und sicheres Reiseziel; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Сейшелы — исключительно безопасный и спокойный курорт; действуют обычные правила предосторожности.
advisory_headline.es: Seychelles es un destino sumamente pacífico y seguro; aplican precauciones normales de viaje.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Seychelles reach approximately 38.4 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Seychelles measure 58.2 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: All inbound travelers must complete the digital Seychelles Travel Authorisation (seychelles.govtas.com) within 10 days before flight departure. Cable & Wireless and Airtel offer tourist eSIMs at Mahé International Airport.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Approved Travel Authorisation certificate is mandatory for boarding flights to Seychelles

tr.conditions: Seyşeller hiçbir ülkeden vize talep etmez; Türk vatandaşları 90 güne kadar vizesizdir. Uçuştan önce online Seyahat İzni (Travel Authorisation) formu doldurulmalıdır.

us.conditions: Seychelles is a visa-free country for all nationalities; visitors must hold an approved Travel Authorisation and hotel booking.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens enter Seychelles visa-free with an approved online Travel Authorisation.

gb.conditions: British citizens do not require a visa for Seychelles; mandatory digital Travel Authorisation must be approved before travel.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ въезжают на Сейшелы без визы на срок до 90 дней при наличии разрешения Travel Authorisation.

dos.title: Complete the Travel Authorisation before flight check-in
dos.description: Airlines will deny boarding without the official digital approval QR code from seychelles.govtas.com.

dos.title: Rent a bicycle on La Digue
dos.description: Motor vehicles are almost entirely prohibited on La Digue island; exploring by bicycle is the quintessential local experience.

dos.title: Respect giant Aldabra tortoises and coral reefs
dos.description: Never feed wild tortoises human food or stand on corals when snorkeling at Saint-Anne Marine National Park.

donts.title: Don't collect Coco de Mer nuts without an official permit
donts.description: The iconic double coconut is an endangered endemic species; unauthorized export carries heavy criminal penalties.

donts.title: Don't swim during strong monsoon riptides
donts.description: Beaches like Anse Intendance on Mahé have dangerous seasonal undertows; heed warning flags.

etiquette.tipping: A 5-10% service charge is usually included in restaurant and hotel bills; leaving small extra cash tips for helpful staff is polite.
